evidence.title: After 100s of millions of safe MMR shots, Trump baselessly said the vaccine is possibly ‘quite lethal’

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC measles cases and outbreaks surveillance data as of Aug. 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: The U.S. had 2,465 confirmed measles cases this year, as of Aug. 6.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: National and international MMR vaccination administration records and safety surveillance databases
occurrences.quote_span: Doctors now have more than 50 years of data on the hundreds of millions of vaccine doses administered in that time.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: Published MMR vaccine safety research and Hviid's interview statement
occurrences.quote_span: Anders Peter Hviid, professor of epidemiology research in Denmark, told PolitiFact there is no evidence that the MMR vaccine is “quite lethal.”
occurrences.speaker: Anders Peter Hviid
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC measles cases and outbreaks surveillance data for 2025 and 2026
occurrences.quote_span: In July, the number of measles cases in the U.S. surpassed all of 2025 , becoming the worst year for the virus since 1991.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: Clinical trial and regulatory review records for combined MMR vaccine immunogenicity and safety
occurrences.quote_span: Scientists rigorously tested whether these vaccines could safely and effectively be combined without reducing the immune responses to each individual illness.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: MMR clinical safety and efficacy studies and U.S. vaccination records since 1971
occurrences.quote_span: “We tell parents what we say for all vaccines that we recommend — they have been rigorously studied for safety and efficacy and (for MMR) given to millions of children over more than 50 years.”
occurrences.speaker: James Campbell
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. regulatory approval records and clinical trial documentation for the first combined MMR vaccine
occurrences.quote_span: U.S. regulators approved the first combined MMR vaccine in 1971 following extensive clinical testing to ensure it was safe and worked well.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC historical measles morbidity and mortality records
occurrences.quote_span: Before the first measles vaccine in 1963, measles killed 400 to 500 Americans every year, most of them young children, and put 48,000 in the hospital, said Dr. Jake Scott, clinical associate professor of infectious diseases at Stanford University School of Medicine.
occurrences.speaker: Jake Scott
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC MMR vaccination schedule
occurrences.quote_span: The MMR vaccine is administered in two doses and given to children first at 12 to 15 months old and then between ages 4 and 6.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC MMR vaccine safety page and underlying vaccine safety studies
occurrences.quote_span: About 1 in 3,000 to 4,000 children younger than 7 years old have febrile seizures caused by a fever approximately 6 to 14 days after vaccination.
occurrences.speaker: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. vaccine administration records and long-term MMR safety surveillance data
occurrences.quote_span: Doctors now have more than 50 years of data on the hundreds of millions of vaccine doses administered in that time.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: James Campbell's Aug. 11, 2026 email interview and MMR vaccine mortality evidence
occurrences.quote_span: Dr. James Campbell, a University of Maryland pediatric infectious diseases expert, said in an email that Trump’s statement about a “5% chance” of lethality is “absolutely ludicrous.”
occurrences.speaker: James Campbell
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC MMR Vaccine Safety page dated July 2024
occurrences.quote_span: The CDC’s page about MMR safety , dated July 2024 — which was still online as Trump made his remarks — said although vaccines can have side effects, most people don’t have serious problems from them.
occurrences.speaker: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: Infectious Diseases Society of America's measles vaccination facts webpage

figure.unit: clinicians, scientists and public health experts

occurrences.quote_span: The Infectious Diseases Society of America , a community of 13,000 clinicians, scientists and public health experts, said on its website: “There have been no deaths shown to be related to the MMR vaccine in healthy people.”
occurrences.speaker: Infectious Diseases Society of America
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC measles herd-immunity guidance and epidemiological transmission models
occurrences.quote_span: When more than 95% of people in a community are vaccinated, most people are protected through community immunity.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: Immunization coverage data and measles, mumps and rubella incidence following changes in vaccination visits
occurrences.quote_span: Requiring six visits rather than two, “would likely lead to drops in immunization coverage which could lead to major resurgences of the diseases,” Dr. Walter Orenstein, an epidemiologist who directed the U.S. Immunization Program from 1998 to 2004, told PolitiFact following Trump’s remarks.
occurrences.speaker: Walter Orenstein
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: MMR vaccine mortality evidence and James Campbell's Aug. 11, 2026 email interview
occurrences.quote_span: “MMR is not lethal at all,” said Campbell, vice chair of the American Academy of Pediatrics Committee on Infectious Diseases.
occurrences.speaker: James Campbell
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: MMR clinical-trial records, vaccination administration records, and safety surveillance data
occurrences.quote_span: “We tell parents what we say for all vaccines that we recommend — they have been rigorously studied for safety and efficacy and (for MMR) given to millions of children over more than 50 years.”

occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: Peer-reviewed MMR vaccine safety studies and adverse-event surveillance

occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC MMR vaccine safety data on febrile seizures

figure.unit: children younger than 7 with febrile seizures

occurrences.quote_span: About 1 in 3,000 to 4,000 children younger than 7 years old have febrile seizures caused by a fever approximately 6 to 14 days after vaccination.

occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC MMR vaccination schedule
occurrences.quote_span: It requires two visits to the pediatrician.

occurrences.checkable_against: Post-licensure MMR safety surveillance reports and adverse-event monitoring systems

occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: MMR vaccine composition and immunology records
occurrences.quote_span: Combining the vaccines was also possible because all three rely on weakened versions of the viruses to trigger immune responses that teach the body to fight the live viruses, Orenstein previously told PolitiFact .
occurrences.speaker: Walter Orenstein
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: MMR vaccine prescribing information and CDC safety documentation
occurrences.quote_span: Because the vaccine is made with a live attenuated virus — a weakened version of the virus — some people may have a stronger immune response, which leads to side effects such as soreness or mild fever.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: CDC MMR vaccine safety page and the two cited epidemiological studies
occurrences.quote_span: Two studies showed that for every 10,000 children who get their first MMR and varicella vaccines as separate shots when they are between 12 months and 23 months, about four will have a febrile seizure during the seven to 10 days following vaccination.

occurrences.subject: MMR vaccine

occurrences.checkable_against: Historical public-health and regulatory records explaining development of the combined MMR vaccine
